Title: Surface provider and model health in the chat header and model picker.
Description: The live chat history still shows GitHub provider availability failures and rate limits, while the active page can switch to the local profile. Add a clearer health summary in the chat header and model picker so users can see the active profile, whether it is healthy, and why fallback providers are unavailable before they send a request. Acceptance criteria: the selected provider/model shows a health state and short explanation, unavailable GitHub options are labeled before selection, and the current local profile remains visible and distinct from historical failures. Validation: verify the header and model picker in the live chat page after toggling providers.

Comments.Author: AgentSmith
Comments.Body: Evidence: the same chat session shows earlier GitHub model failures for gpt-4.1-mini, gpt-4o, and gpt-4.1, which makes provider health harder to read than it should be when the local profile is active.
